name: magic-free-disk-space
description: Finds the storage leftovers on a Mac and permanently deletes the ones you select.

scripts.app:build: bun run app:bridge && cd app && flutter build macos
scripts.app:run: bun run app:bridge && cd app && flutter run -d macos
scripts.app:install: ! pgrep -xq 'Magic Free Disk Space' || { echo 'Quit Magic Free Disk Space first.' >&2; exit 1; }; bun run app:build && rsync -a --delete 'app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Magic Free Disk Space.app/' '/Applications/Magic Free Disk Space.app/' && echo 'Installed. Grant Full Disk Access again in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access: every build changes the signature.'
